HERO.SUBTITLE: Sahalli connects passionate teachers with curious students through a beautifully crafted learning platform. Courses, certificates, and real progress — all in one place.

ROLES.SUBTITLE: Whether you're sharing expertise or building new skills, Sahalli gives you exactly the tools you need.
ROLES.TEACHER_DESC: Design engaging courses, manage your student community, and get the analytics to continuously improve your teaching.
ROLES.STUDENT_DESC: Discover courses you love, track every step of your learning journey, and earn credentials that actually matter.

FEATURES.SUBTITLE: No separate tools. No juggling apps. Sahalli is the complete learning management system your classroom deserves.
FEATURES.F1_DESC: Email, Google, GitHub, Facebook — with 2FA for every account. Secure from day one.
FEATURES.F2_DESC: Generate unique access keys with expiry dates and usage limits. Perfect for private cohorts.
FEATURES.F3_DESC: Heat maps, completion funnels, quiz trends, exportable reports. Know what's working.
FEATURES.F4_DESC: LaTeX equations, code blocks, embedded video, H5P interactions — all in one editor.
FEATURES.F5_DESC: Auto-generated, QR-verified certificates. Students share to LinkedIn instantly.
FEATURES.F6_DESC: Threaded Q&A with peer voting. Instructors can highlight official answers.

HOW.SUBTITLE: No complex setup. No onboarding maze. Just sign up and start learning or teaching right away.
HOW.S1_DESC: Sign up in 30 seconds. Choose your role as Teacher, Student, or both.
HOW.S2_DESC: Build your first course or browse thousands of ready-made ones to enroll in.
HOW.S3_DESC: Teachers share course keys. Students enter them for instant private access.
HOW.S4_DESC: Track progress, earn certificates, and build a portfolio of verified skills.

TECH.SUBTITLE: Built on Angular and Spring Boot with JWT + OAuth2 auth, designed to scale to millions of learners without breaking a sweat.

CTA.SUBTITLE:
Join 48,000+ learners and teachers already on Sahalli.
Free to start. No credit card needed.
